messages:
maya (Design): Dropped a compact-table mock for the Rules list in the preview: https://internal.redwood.dev/preview/compact-v3

ben (Product): Quick q: does compact mode hide descriptions or just tighten spacing?

maya (Design): Tightens spacing, shrinks badges, swaps thumbnails for icons. Descriptions remain behind an inline chevron expand.

sam (Eng): Touch reorder: small handles are hard to tap.

maya (Design): Increased handle hit target to 12px and added keyboard reorder shortcuts: Cmd+Alt+ArrowUp / Cmd+Alt+ArrowDown (docs in preview).

elaine (A11y): Surface keyboard hints in tooltips and the accessibility help modal. Ensure the handle exposes aria-grabbed and a visible focus ring.

ben (Product): Seeing occasional "Order conflict" toast when saving order, but save succeeds. Could be optimistic UI vs backend race.

sam (Eng): I'll add a 500ms debounce and only show the toast for explicit errors.

maya (Design): Simulator shows mismatched prefix-match counts for some flows. @ben is that the stale cache issue?

ben (Product): Yep, simulator used an older ruleset cache. Will invalidate on edits so preview matches current rules.

design-bot: Screenshot uploaded: compact-table-v3.png

elaine (A11y): Contrast nit: priority chip text in compact mode is borderline AA at 14px. Consider bolder weight or reversed chips for top priorities.

maya (Design): I'll mock reversed chips for priorities 1-3 and bolder type.

sam (Eng): When toggling a row expand with Space, does focus trap inside the panel? It currently escapes.

maya (Design): It should trap until Esc; will fix interaction in mock.

ben (Product): Add helper microcopy under rules: "Compact view shows more rules on small screens. Drag to reorder or use keyboard shortcuts."

elaine (A11y): Add aria-label="Toggle compact rules view" and aria-pressed for the compact toggle. Include the shortcuts in accessibility overview.

maya (Design): Will push v3 tonight. Once design-bot posts alternate mock I'll pick and we can merge CSS tweaks + sam's debounce. Thanks! :thumbsup:
